intro:
You keep the decision record of a move to a new edge network. Decisions and their reasons change, the user sets and lifts constraints, and open questions get answers or stay open.

Initial specification:
- [e001] The architecture review approved `sin-shield` as the decision on the origin shield region, as Sami noted in the minutes.
- [e002] The architecture review approved `bunny-edge` as the decision on the edge vendor, as Rosa noted in the minutes.
- [e003] In the design meeting, the group chose `sigsci-waf`, and Tove recorded it as the decision on the edge firewall.
- [e004] The architecture review approved `imageflow-svc` as the decision on the image optimizer, as Bo noted in the minutes.
- [e005] In the design meeting, the group chose `sectigo-dv`, and Bo recorded it as the decision on the certificate issuer.
- [e006] In the design meeting, the group chose `60`, and Hana recorded it as the decision on the default edge TTL in seconds.
- [e007] The minutes by Kira give the motive of the choice, so the reason for the decision on the origin shield region is `why-vendor-support`.
- [e008] In the decision log, Dara wrote down that the reason for the decision on the edge vendor is `why-latency`.
- [e009] Vik recorded why the group chose it, and the reason for the decision on the edge firewall is `why-lock-in`.
- [e010] In the decision log, Eli wrote down that the reason for the decision on the image optimizer is `why-latency`.
- [e011] In the call with the user, Uma noted that the status of the constraint cn-no-js-at-edge is `in-force` from now on.
- [e012] In the call with the user, Kira noted that the status of the constraint cn-us-eu-pops is `in-force` from now on.
- [e013] In the review, Eli recorded that the answer to the open question oq-http3 is `still-open`.
- [e014] Vik brought the question to the meeting, and the answer to the open question oq-rollback-owner is `still-open` for now.
- [e015] Mei brought the question to the meeting, and the answer to the open question oq-log-sink is `still-open` for now.
- [e016] In the review, Dara recorded that the answer to the open question oq-cutover-day is `still-open`.
- [e017] Jun brought the question to the meeting, and the answer to the open question oq-ipv6 is `still-open` for now.

Rules for this task:
- A value changes only by an event that decides, answers, corrects, assigns, links or reviews it. A proposal with no decision, a withdrawn draft, a question, a link to a page and an archived copy change nothing.
- A correction or a new entry replaces the earlier value. The earlier value is then superseded.
- The initial specification gives the first value of each item.
- A question about the values of an item "at some point" counts every value from the initial specification on, up to the time of the question. The value "directly before" the current value is the value that the current value replaced.
- Some decisions have a recorded reason. The closed list of reason ids is `why-latency`, `why-price`, `why-compliance`, `why-vendor-support`, `why-feature-set`, `why-lock-in`.
- Each decision with a recorded reason has one reason at a time. An entry that records a reason for it replaces the earlier reason. A later entry can replace the reason and keep the decision. A new decision with no such entry keeps the earlier reason.
- The user sets constraints and can lift them later. A constraint is `in-force` or `lifted`.
- An open question has the answer `still-open` until an entry answers it. A later entry can replace an answer.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
